tools.name: lookup_word
tools.description: Use this when the user asks about a Japanese word: what it means, how to read or pronounce it, its pitch accent, whether it is a godan or ichidan verb, how to conjugate it (te-form, past, polite, potential…), or how to say something in Japanese. Searches the 9,040 JLPT words (N5–N1) of Japanese Skil

tools.name: lookup_kanji
tools.description: Use this when the user asks about a kanji (a Chinese character used in Japanese): which JLPT words use it and how it is read in them, at which JLPT level it first appears, or where to learn it. For each kanji given (up to five), lists the words in the site’s JLPT word list that contain it, easiest l

tools.name: find_grammar
tools.description: Use this when the user asks about a Japanese grammar pattern or particle (〜てもいい, ために, ば vs たら, は and が), what it means, how it is used, an example of it, or how to say something with a pattern. Searches the site’s 828 grammar points (N5–N1) by the pattern in Japanese or romaji, or by its meaning in

tools.description: Use this when the user asks how to study Japanese or prepare for a JLPT level with Japanese Skills · 言の葉, or what study material the site has.
